title: Derived factors of the finite realization
statement: For every finite coefficient complex P, the ordinary-coordinate factor followed by localization of the degreewise finite realization is the intrinsic exact-derived pullback factor. No K-flatness is required.

source.place: Tag 07A4, proof of lemma-pullback-tensor-product; Tag 06YS for K-flat resolutions; ordinary sheaf tensor pullback in modules on sites, Tag 03EL.

proof.text: Expand the ordinary-coordinate factor as inverse derived realization followed by the ordinary factor. Naturality of the derived realization with its factorization maps identifies the latter factor followed by localized realization with derived realization followed by intrinsic factor. Cancel the inverse derived realization.

proof_origin.place: Explicit homogeneous-generator and flat-resolution calculations from the proof of Tag 07A4.

theorem finitePullbackTensor_realization_factors {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ) :
    letI : (sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).Additive :=
      sfIntrinsicPullback_additive (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    (FinitePullbackTensorRep.factors l E f n).hom.app P ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (pullbackTensorFiniteRealization l E f n)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) =
    (sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
      P
